mapper.select: SELECT id, space_id, COALESCE(photo_class, '') AS photo_class, COALESCE(photo, '') AS photo, COALESCE(zoom, '') AS zoom, COALESCE(pos, '') AS pos, caption, sort_order FROM life_facility_photos ORDER BY space_id, sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO life_facility_photos (space_id, photo_class, photo, zoom, pos, caption, sort_order) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{photoClass}, #{photo}, #{zoom}, #{pos}, #{caption}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT space_id AS "spaceId", badge AS "badge" FROM life_facility_spaces
